label: Daily allowance
hint: Computed from the trip itself; no receipts needed.

label: Hotel / accommodation
hint: Bills in the category Accommodation. Itemise the breakfast and the city tax.

label: Transportation
hint: Train, flight, taxi, parking and tolls (receipts) and the mileage table for a private car.

label: Food
hint: Meals while travelling are covered by the allowance. Entertaining a business partner is Business meals (70 % rule) with participants and occasion.

label: Material
hint: Equipment, printing and samples bought for the trip.

label: Cost centre / project
hint: Choose the customer or project the trip is charged to, or choose general explicitly.
